source.text: Aakhri Sanghursh is a Hindi action film of Bollywood directed by Narendra Bedi and produced by G.M. Patel. This film was released in 1997 in the banner of G.M. Productions & Jawahar Picture Palace.
source.title: Aakhri Sanghursh

source.text: Narendra Bedi (1937 - 21 October 1982) was a Bollywood director and son of the writer Rajinder Singh Bedi. He is most known for hits movies like "Jawani Diwani" (1972) starring Randhir Kapoor and Jaya Bhaduri, Rajesh Khanna starrers "Bandhan" and "Maha Chor" , and Amitabh Bachchan starrers "Benaam" (1974) and "Adalat" (1977) and the comedy film "Rafoo Chakkar" .
source.title: Narendra Bedi
